name: External Marketplaces Links for WooCommerce
author: Dzemal Imamovic

sections.description:
This plugin lets you attach marketplace URLs to WooCommerce products and render them as buttons or logos on product pages. Built with security best practices: sanitized URLs, no mixed content, safe rel attributes.

Features

  • Add marketplace URLs in a product metabox
  • Choose display type: Text Buttons or Image Logos
  • Configure image size and text size
  • Optional text labels next to logos
  • Secure output: sanitized/validated URLs, noopener and nofollow attributes

Usage

  • Edit a WooCommerce product and add marketplace URLs in the “External Marketplace Links” metabox
  • Adjust display settings under WooCommerce > Settings > Marketplace Links
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
sections.faq:
Which marketplaces are supported?

Amazon, eBay, Walmart, AliExpress, Etsy, Wayfair, Rakuten, Shopee, Wildberries, Ozon, Flipkart, JD, MercadoLibre, Coupang, Trendyol, Noon, Allegro, Cdiscount, Lazada, Tokopedia, Zalando, Otto, Target.

Does this add outbound links automatically?

Only the URLs that you save per product are shown. No hidden or promotional links are injected.
